## Exhibition to be held 18th & 19th August 2026 in New Delhi India.

## We invite you & your team members to join the producibility & knowledgeable conference &
## exhibition. Refining & Petrochemicals Technology forum brings together the key industry players
## in the market to discuss the current issues and future opportunities in the industry. Last year
## 70+ Speakers & 200+ delegates from over 100 global organizations participated .
## The Conference builds upon the knowledge of experts & industry stakeholders defining critical
## areas of collaboration including:- Lubricants, Refining Technologies & Catalysts, Petrochemicals
## & Polymers, Pipeline Maintenance & Inspection, Fuels & Additives, Alternate Energy, Bio-Energy,
## Nanotechnology, E-Mobility, IndS_UP  StartUp Scheme, Biotechnology and Geo-tectonic, fertilizer,
## Power & Energy, sustainable energy, Materials, Production & design, Laboratory, Refinery and
## petrochemical industry, Downstream, Midstream, renewable fuels, sustainability, commercial
## opportunities, regulatory compliances, Operational excellence & asset optimization, process
## technology innovations, Maintenance & reliability, catalyst developments & regional market
## trends.  
## The Forum will comprise of case study presentations from thought leaders, panel discussions,
## workshops and master classes addressing a wide range of pertinent topics. The two day Conclave
## was focused on various issues of the Refinery & Petrochemical ecosystem like strategies of
## industry, Government Initiatives to stimulate innovation and attract investment,
## Industry-Academia – Government Partnership and Venture Funding. The conference was structured to
## enable the participants to interact meaningfully with the experts from Government, industry and
## academia, companies.

Energy Security and Reliable Supply
More than just an integrated group in the hydrocarbons industry, SONATRACH mobilizes all its energy
to ensure the country’s energy security, to honour its contractual commitments to its clients,
conducts its operations with a view to preserving the interests of future generations and respecting
the environment.
SONATRACH commits all its energy to a sustainable development
[Energy Security and Reliable Supply]
Sécurité énergétique et approvisionnement fiable
Energy Security and Reliable Supply
SONATRACH, mobilizes all its resources to ensure Algeria’s energy security and satisfy the local
hydrocarbon market.
[Sécurité énergétique et approvisionnement fiable]
Éthique et transparence
Ethics and Transparency
Ethics and Transparency are at the core of SONATRACH’s managerial culture.
Its governance system is guided by stringent managerial standards and procedures.
[Éthique et transparence]
Engagement climatique
Climate Commitment
SONATRACH place la réduction de son empreinte carbone au centre de sa stratégie, et s’engage
activement dans la préservation de l’environnement pour les générations futures.
[Engagement climatique]
Responsabilité sociétale et développement durable
Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development
SONATRACH ensures a rational development of the natural resources and keeps up a constant dialogue
with the stakeholders in order to ensure acceptability and sustainability for its projects
[Responsabilité sociétale et développement durable]
Valorisation du contenu local
Promoting Local content
SONATRACH adopts a development policy promoting recourse to Local Content.
-By maximizing partnership with Algerian companies for its investments and projects , SONATRACH
actively participates in strengthening the local industrial network.
[Valorisation du contenu local]

## Our Differentiators

[Safety first]

Safety first


Our founding principle is risk elimination. We achieve this by replacing dangerous rope access and
manual methods with UAS technology, ensuring zero compromise on the wellbeing of personnel and asset
uptime. We keep people out of harm's way, every single day.

[Cyberhawk Icons 30]

Technical leadership


We innovate at the convergence of aviation and software. Cyberhawk's iHawk platform and proprietary
AI models deliver a true end-to-end aerial intelligence solution, turning massive volumes of raw
data into decisive, actionable maintenance plans faster than any traditional method.

[Cyberhawk Icons 02]

Global expertise


We deploy the industry's largest and most highly trained network of certified pilots and inspection
engineers. This expertise guarantees consistent, high-fidelity data collection and accurate defect
analysis at every asset, ensuring the integrity and quality of the aerial intelligence we collect.

[Cyberhawk Icons 23]

ESG impact


We are partners in sustainability. By reducing the need for costly, high-carbon site visits and
providing verifiable data for emissions compliance and asset longevity, we help customers meet
critical decarbonization and governance goals across their entire portfolio.

### Purchase

When we are purchasing your product as an off taker we ensure that our ship or barge arrives as
scheduled at your facility for loading, or when we receive your product we ensure smooth operations
of your delivering vessel to receive your product.

### Inspect

The quality and quantity of products we buy or sell, including the tanks of transporting vessels are
checked by world class independent inspection companies we hire with our transacting partners to
ensure quality and quantity assurance.

### Transport

The ships / vessel we use in transporting your goods carry international classifications,
certifications and insurances.

### Documentation

Our documentation team is experienced in preparing both import/export documentation to/for your
country as well as quality and quantity documentation for your cargo.

### Storage

We strategically use storage globally.

### Delivery

When we are delivering the product to you at your terminal or to your nominated ship/barge we ensure
that our ship or barge arrives as scheduled at your facility for discharging our product at your
terminal, or when we load our product to your nominated ship we ensure smooth operations of your
receiving vessel to receive your product.

[ Our services ][41]

## With expertise in virology, we tailor solutions to meet specific requirements of your lentiviral

### Business model

GMP CDMO focused on different stages of the process.

### Specialization

We work exclusively in lentivirus, offering comprehensive services.

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

Key Operations
Zenith Eclipse specializes in cultivating, processing, and distributing high-quality grains,
lentils, and seeds—including sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, and rapeseeds. With modern facilities, we
produce wheat flour and related wheat products to meet market needs.

wider industrial demand and strengthening our reach across multiple sectors.
Our presence stretches across 40+ nations, marking us as a key player in connecting high-quality

We’re committed to providing seeds you can count on—quality, reliable supply, and a responsible
approach from sourcing to delivery. We work to meet your needs and expectations while supporting
long-term, sustainable growth across the agricultural sector.

### Quality You Can Trust

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

## Innovation in Action

We champion a culture of innovation across our agriculture, energy, petrochemicals, and logistics
divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

Operating in over many countries, our influence is truly global—we help feed populations and fuel
industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and
environmental initiatives, and invest in the well‑being of the regions we call home. By balancing
worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared
prosperity for communities and customers alike.

We are committed to excellence in every delivery.

Our expansive global network ensures precise and efficient logistics services, connecting businesses
to markets seamlessly. Each hub is equipped to provide tailored logistics solutions, customized to
meet the unique demands of various industries. To discover how we can adapt our services to your
specific needs, reach out to our team of experts, who will guide you through our versatile logistics
capabilities. Whether you're a startup or a multinational corporation, our dedication to consistent
and reliable service remains unwavering, helping you succeed in the ever-evolving global
marketplace.

### [What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?

Our mission is to transform lives, industries, and communities through unparalleled solutions in
global agribusiness, energy, and logistics. By placing safety, sustainability, and well-being at the
heart of every endeavor, we strive to build a future where innovation and responsibility flourish
side by side.

### [What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?

We envision a thriving, interconnected world where breakthroughs in agriculture, petrochemicals, and
logistics drive prosperity for all. At Zenith Eclipse Co, we continuously push boundaries and
redefine global standards, connecting people and businesses in a shared quest for a more sustainable
and progressive tomorrow.

Zenith Eclipse Co is not just a company—it’s a movement. Operating in over 40 countries, we bridge
the gap between top-quality products and the most demanding international markets. Our commitment to
excellence underpins a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, fueling our vision of a globally
unified community that transcends conventional business norms.

### [Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?] Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?

We support a diverse spectrum of industries, spanning agribusiness, renewable energy,
petrochemicals, logistics, and beyond. Our expertise allows us to integrate cutting-edge solutions
into complex supply chains and emerging markets, ensuring every partner benefits from our depth of
knowledge and global reach.

### [What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach to sustainability?] What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach
### to sustainability?

Sustainability is woven into our DNA. From responsible resource use to eco-friendly innovations in
transport and product development, every stage of our operation aims to reduce environmental impact
and uplift local communities. We believe that true progress requires safeguarding the planet for
generations to come.

### [How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?] How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?

We welcome collaborations with individuals, organizations, and governments who share our passion for
delivering value, promoting sustainable growth, and elevating global standards. Whether you’re
seeking premium agribusiness products, advanced logistics solutions, or forward-thinking energy
strategies, our dedicated experts will help tailor a partnership that aligns with your ambitions—and
helps realize them on a global stage.

# From seed plantingto the final
# delivery of goods

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

[icon]
Key Operations
Zenith Eclipse specializes in cultivating, processing, and distributing high-quality grains,
lentils, and seeds—including sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, and rapeseeds. With modern facilities, we
produce wheat flour and related wheat products to meet market needs.
[icon]
Expansion into Petrochemicals
We’ve also expanded into petrochemicals—including ethylene, propylene, and polyethylene—supporting
wider industrial demand and strengthening our reach across multiple sectors.
Our presence stretches across 40+ nations, marking us as a key player in connecting high-quality
products with the markets that need them most. 40+

### Commitment and Responsibility

We’re committed to providing seeds you can count on—quality, reliable supply, and a responsible
approach from sourcing to delivery. We work to meet your needs and expectations while supporting
long-term, sustainable growth across the agricultural sector.

### Quality You Can Trust

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

## Innovation in Action

We champion a culture of innovation across our agriculture, energy, petrochemicals, and logistics
divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

Operating in over many countries, our influence is truly global—we help feed populations and fuel
industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and
environmental initiatives, and invest in the well‑being of the regions we call home. By balancing
worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared
prosperity for communities and customers alike.

## Empowering Our People

Our people are the driving force behind our success. We invest in their growth through continuous
training, mentorship programs, and a culture that rewards teamwork and innovation. Whether on the
farm, in energy facilities, at petrochemical plants, or in our logistics centers, every team member
is empowered to contribute ideas and drive positive change. By nurturing talent and recognizing
achievement, we ensure our employees thrive—because when our people excel, so does our company and
the communities we serve.

## Collaborate with Us

Partnering with us means choosing a path to success. We offer competitive pricing, exceptional
customer service, and a commitment to excellence in everything we do. Our wide selection of seeds,
including flaxseeds, rapeseeds, mustard seeds, and coriander seeds, is designed to help you meet
your business goals. Together, we can cultivate a more sustainable and flavorful future for all.
We are committed to excellence in every delivery.

Our expansive global network ensures precise and efficient logistics services, connecting businesses
to markets seamlessly. Each hub is equipped to provide tailored logistics solutions, customized to
meet the unique demands of various industries. To discover how we can adapt our services to your
specific needs, reach out to our team of experts, who will guide you through our versatile logistics
capabilities. Whether you're a startup or a multinational corporation, our dedication to consistent
and reliable service remains unwavering, helping you succeed in the ever-evolving global
marketplace.

### [What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?

Our mission is to transform lives, industries, and communities through unparalleled solutions in
global agribusiness, energy, and logistics. By placing safety, sustainability, and well-being at the
heart of every endeavor, we strive to build a future where innovation and responsibility flourish
side by side.

### [What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?

We envision a thriving, interconnected world where breakthroughs in agriculture, petrochemicals, and
logistics drive prosperity for all. At Zenith Eclipse Co, we continuously push boundaries and
redefine global standards, connecting people and businesses in a shared quest for a more sustainable
and progressive tomorrow.

### [How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?] How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?

Zenith Eclipse Co is not just a company—it’s a movement. Operating in over 40 countries, we bridge
the gap between top-quality products and the most demanding international markets. Our commitment to
excellence underpins a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, fueling our vision of a globally
unified community that transcends conventional business norms.

### [Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?] Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?

We support a diverse spectrum of industries, spanning agribusiness, renewable energy,
petrochemicals, logistics, and beyond. Our expertise allows us to integrate cutting-edge solutions
into complex supply chains and emerging markets, ensuring every partner benefits from our depth of
knowledge and global reach.

### [What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach to sustainability?] What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach
### to sustainability?

Sustainability is woven into our DNA. From responsible resource use to eco-friendly innovations in
transport and product development, every stage of our operation aims to reduce environmental impact
and uplift local communities. We believe that true progress requires safeguarding the planet for
generations to come.

### [How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?] How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?

We welcome collaborations with individuals, organizations, and governments who share our passion for
delivering value, promoting sustainable growth, and elevating global standards. Whether you’re
seeking premium agribusiness products, advanced logistics solutions, or forward-thinking energy
strategies, our dedicated experts will help tailor a partnership that aligns with your ambitions—and
helps realize them on a global stage.
